meta.name: obsidian-vault-maintainer
meta.description: Maintain an Obsidian-friendly memory wiki vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and official Obsidian CLI awareness.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 维护 Obsidian 知识库的 wiki 链接、元数据和结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Obsidian 管理个人知识库并需要自动化维护
copy.tagline_en: Maintain wiki links, frontmatter, and structure in your Obsidian vault
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for personal knowledge management and need automated vault maintenance

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用专用命令维护适合 Obsidian 的 wiki，包括使用双链链接、前置元数据，并配合官方 Obsidian CLI 做搜索、打开、执行命令等操作。
howto.when: 当记忆 wiki 的渲染模式为 obsidian，或你希望 wiki 与 Obsidian 兼容时触发。

say.text: 用 Obsidian 模式查看 wiki 状态。
帮我用双链链接创建一篇新笔记。

howto.what_en: Claude uses dedicated commands to maintain an Obsidian-friendly wiki, employing wikilinks, proper frontmatter, and leveraging the official Obsidian CLI for search, open, command, and daily note actions when available.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the memory-wiki vault render mode is 'obsidian' or the user requests Obsidian compatibility.

say_en.text: Check wiki status in Obsidian mode.
say_en.note: Claude runs status command and checks CLI availability.

say_en.text: Create a new note with wikilinks for me.
